platform.heading: Ward 5
platform.card1Desc: Growth is coming to Oakville — the question is how we manage it. I support carefully planned, balanced growth that protects our neighbourhoods and provides housing for families, seniors and young professionals without excessive density on the Trafalgar corridor.
platform.card1Item1: Housing for Families, Seniors & Young Professionals
platform.card2Desc: Traffic congestion is one of the most common concerns I hear. As Ward 5 grows, we need faster, more reliable transit that connects residents throughout Oakville and offers a real alternative to driving.
platform.card2Item2: Trafalgar is a density corridor. Let's have transit to match
platform.card3Desc: Leadership is about more than attending meetings and casting votes. It means listening, communicating openly and bringing groups of residents together. Ward 5 deserves a councillor who is accessible, accountable and always puts residents first.
platform.card3Item2: A Strong Voice for Ward 5 at Town Hall

community.heading: A Proven
community.caption: Sue has been a Ward 5 fixture for years, building local groups and connecting people, showing action, not just words.
community.s1Body: Throughout her life, Sue has believed that strong communities are built when people come together. That belief inspired her to found Hockey Cares, chair SafetyNet, and volunteer with SAVIS — serving residents through sport, community safety, and support.
community.s2Body: Sue founded Hockey Cares in 2017 as a reconciliation initiative that unites Indigenous and non-Indigenous youth through hockey and cultural exchange. What began as a local project has grown into a nationally recognized program.
community.s3Col1Desc: Receives the Canadian Real Estate Association CARE Award - a national honour recognizing Sue’s contributions to community well-being.
community.s3Col2Desc: Sue receives the King Charles III Medal for founding Hockey Cares.
community.s3Closing: Sport can be a powerful bridge between communities.
community.s4Body: As a successful Oakville realtor, Sue has spent years helping families find a place to call home. Every day, she hears what residents love about Oakville and what they want protected for future generations — strong neighbourhoods, excellent schools, parks, and community spirit.
community.s5Body: Sue is running because Ward 5 deserves a councillor who listens, acts, and always puts residents first. With a track record of founding programs, earning national recognition, and serving the community every day, she will continue to lead.

testimonials.heading: What Residents Are Saying
testimonials.t1Quote: Sue brings people together. She is an effective listener, a thoughtful leader, and someone who approaches challenges with integrity, compassion, and a focus on practical solutions.
testimonials.t1Role: Executive Director, SafetyNet Children’s & Youth Charities
testimonials.t2Quote: Sue’s commitment goes far beyond organizing a program. She is deeply invested in the well-being of our youth and the strength of our community. She continues to show up, year after year, building trust and ensuring the program grows in a way that respects our culture and values.
testimonials.t2Role: Youth Outreach Coordinator, Constance Lake First Nation
testimonials.t3Quote: Sue is smart, energetic and deeply committed to her family, friends and community. She listens carefully, values different perspectives and leads with both compassion and common sense. When Sue takes on a challenge, she follows through and delivers results.

about.introP1: Ward 5 is entering an important new chapter, and I believe we have an opportunity to shape that future in a way that protects what residents value most while preparing our community for the years ahead.
about.introP2: That's why I am running for Ward 5 Councillor.
about.introP3: These three priorities will guide every decision I make on behalf of residents.
about.bioP1: Oakville has been my home, my community, and my passion for many years.
about.bioP2: Throughout my life, I have believed that strong communities are built when people come together to support one another, solve problems, and create opportunities for others.
about.bioP3Pre: That belief inspired me to found
about.bioP3Post: — helping youth through sport, bringing together community partners, and supporting individuals and families during some of life's most difficult moments.
about.bioP4: These experiences taught me how to listen, how to bring people together, and how to turn ideas into action.
about.bioP5: As a successful Oakville realtor, I have spent years helping families find a place to call home — hearing what residents love about Oakville and what they want protected for future generations. Those are the values I will work to protect.
about.sgP1: Growth is coming to Oakville. The question is how we manage it.
about.sgP2: I support growth that is carefully planned, balanced and supported by the infrastructure our community needs. That means creating housing options for families, seniors and young professionals while protecting the character of our neighbourhoods.
about.sgP3: I do not believe our future should be defined by excessive density concentrated along the Trafalgar corridor. Communities such as Oak Park and Queens Avenue show that growth can be achieved through a thoughtful mix of housing types that create complete and livable neighbourhoods.
about.sgP4: Growth should serve residents — not the other way around.
about.btP1: Traffic congestion is one of the most common concerns I hear from residents.
about.btP2: As Ward 5 continues to grow, we need transportation solutions that work for today's residents and tomorrow's population.
about.btP3: I will advocate for faster, more reliable transit service, better connections throughout Oakville, and transportation planning that focuses on moving people efficiently rather than simply adding more cars to our roads.
about.btP4: Residents deserve transit that is practical, convenient and a real alternative to driving.
about.slP1: Leadership is about more than attending meetings and casting votes.
about.slP2: It is about listening, communicating openly, building relationships and standing up for residents when important decisions are being made.
about.slP3: I believe residents deserve a councillor who is accessible, accountable and engaged with the community.
about.slP4: I will hold regular community meetings, provide clear communication, seek resident input and ensure that Ward 5 has a strong voice at Town Hall.
about.slP5: My commitment is to work collaboratively, ask tough questions when necessary and always put residents first.
about.whyP1: With Ward 5 continuing to grow and evolve, the decisions we make today will shape our community for decades to come.
about.whyP2: I am running because I believe we can embrace growth while protecting what makes Oakville special — and because residents deserve practical solutions to traffic congestion and infrastructure challenges.
about.whyP3: And I am running because strong communities are built through listening, collaboration and leadership.
about.whyP4: Together, we can build a future that works for current residents, future generations and everyone who chooses to call Ward 5 home.
about.joinP1: This campaign is about our community and our future.
about.joinP2: I invite you to share your ideas, volunteer, place a lawn sign, attend an event or simply start a conversation about the future of Ward 5.
about.joinP3: Together, we can build Ward 5's future.
